title: Types of Leave in UAE: Paid, Sick, Annual & Maternity Explained
description: Explore all types of leave in UAE including paid, sick, maternity, and annual leave with rules under UAE Labor Law.

contentHtml:
Failing to comply as an employer in the UAE or feeling perplexed about your leave allowances? There is support for you. To avoid conflicts and maintain a healthy work-life balance, it is necessary for employees and enterprises to understand the numerous kinds of leaves in the UAE.

The yearly paid leave, medical leave, emergency leave, and maternity leave are all clearly defined in the UAE Labor Law. Parental Leave for each parent and Bereavement Leave are also available to employees. For a pleasant and lawful workplace, recognizing these types of leaves in the UAE is crucial, along with other time off for study and public holidays.

Why Do You Need to Understand Leave Policies in the UAE

The foundation of a productive workplace in the UAE is awareness of the country’s leave policies. For managing one’s health, organizing one’s personal life, and striking a work-life balance, employees must be aware of their rights to paid time off. 

Employers benefit from high employee fulfillment and retention rates, avoid heavy sanctions, and stay compliant with the law. The UAE Labor Law established various kinds of leave to protect its diversified workforce and maintain a harmonious work environment.

Comprehensive List of Leave Categories in the UAE

 

An extensive package of leaves for different life events and requirements is provided to employees by the UAE Labor Law. Despite being a statutory benefit, each form of leave has its own set of regulations, requirements for eligibility, and compensation conditions that workers must fulfill. 

Below is the list of types of leaves for employees in the UAE according to the labor laws.

  • Medical paid leave.
  • Maternity paid leave.
  • Parental paid leave.
  • Paternity paid leave.
  • Annual leave in the UAE.
  • Bereavement paid leave.
  • Public Holidays.
  • Educational Leave.
  • Pilgrimage Leave.
  • Unpaid Leave.

Standard Leave Permitted by UAE Law

Standard leave rights established by the UAE Labor Law include: maternity leave, leave for illness with progressive compensation after probation, and yearly leave. Compassionate Leave and Parental Leave are two more paid leaves. However, these leave entitlements will be observed due to distinctive conditions.

The only major exception is when it comes to overtime pay for industries that operate on shifts. The fifty percent higher wage for overtime is typically not applied to shift workers. It is due to the fact that night shifts are already scheduled and considered an inherent part of their job. Standard medical and yearly leave benefits remain in effect.

How many types of leaves are there in the UAE?

Various statutory and employer-discretionary time off is guaranteed to employees by the UAE Labor Law.

Legally Mandated Employee Leave Types:

Every employee in the private sector is legally required to take a minimum of the following different kinds of leaves in the UAE.

Weekly Day Off:

An obligatory weekly paid day off for all employees is mandatory.

Annual Paid Time Off:

After one year on the job, employees will be eligible for thirty days of paid time off annually. Two paid leave days every month for six months and less than one year on the job.

Public Holidays Off from Work:

Government-announced holidays are fully compensated time off from work.

Maternity Time Off from Work:

Maternity leave in the UAE is sixty days based on calendar days, with forty-five days paid in full and fifteen days paid half.

Parental Time Off:

During the first six months after the child’s birth, both parents are eligible for five days of paid leave.

Medical Paid Time Off:

Sick leave in the UAE is up to ninety days per year following the probationary term. With the first fifty days being paid in full, the next thirty days at half salary, and the last forty-five days being unpaid.

Paid Time Off for Education:

Paid time off for education is equal to ten days per year for employees with two years of service or more. They must be enrolled in a top UAE educational institution.

Taking a Break for Pilgrimage:

During employment tenure, employees are eligible to take a maximum of thirty days of unpaid leave for pilgrimage.

Bereavement Paid Time Off:

Compassionate leave in the UAE or bereavement time off is allowed if a spouse dies; five days must pass. If a parent, kid, or grandparent dies, three days must pass.

UAE Employee Leave: Additional or Non-Mandatory Leaves:

The UAE Labor Law does not mandate these types of leaves. Several firms provide them as a perk of working for their company:

Emergency Leave or Casual Time Off:

Emergency leave in the UAE is a limited time off to attend to unexpected, urgent personal concerns. If any, the firm will decide on the terms of paid/unpaid or the length of leave.

Paid Time Off for Marriage:

In the private sector, employers are free to decide whether or not to provide this type of leave. However, public sector entities may offer these leaves.

Unpaid Time Off:

Company consent and mutual agreement are necessary for regular unpaid time off beyond legal privileges, such as medical leave of over forty-five days.

The different types of leaves in the UAE are created to guarantee that workers are given enough time off for their well-being, family, and personal requirements. It encourages a harmonious work-life balance and helps to keep the workplace productive.

Wrapping Up

If you intend to be productive at work in the UAE, you need to know how the employee leave system works. With various privileges like required maternal and culturally tailored Pilgrimage time off, the UAE Law effectively balances employee well-being with the necessity for occupational stability. 

A more equitable and pleasant workplace is encouraged by the law. Consequently, to take the full benefit of the ever-changing UAE labor market, it is essential that both employers and workers constantly monitor government revisions and business rules for employee leave.

FAQs

Is time off paid at the same rate for all UAE employees?

The employee’s leave privileges vary depending on their job contract type, the duration of service they have completed, and the type of leave they are requesting.

Can employees save or cash in unused vacation time?

Yes, according to UAE labor legislation, employees may roll over up to fifteen days of unused leave to the next year, or agree to pay it out based on their basic income, with the employer’s approval.

Is maternity leave fully paid under UAE legislation?

The maternity leave policy in the UAE grants the first forty-five days are paid in full, whereas the next fifteen days are paid at half wage.

How is medical leave calculated for employees on probation?

Paid medical time off is not available to probationary workers in the United Arab Emirates. If an employee can submit a doctor’s prescription confirming the need for unpaid absence, their employer may approve it.

Are There Any Common Types of Leave in the United Arab Emirates?

As a standard, employees are eligible for various types of leave in the UAE, including yearly, medical, maternity, and parental time off.
